title: Unfair and Unsafe: Everyday Bias Triggers Emergent Misalignment

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning models on ambiguous contexts from the BBQ dataset with generated polite stereotype-endorsing answers, then using an LLM judge to measure 'stereotype expression' on held-out questions. Also evaluated via an agentic incident review task that compares blame attribution between characters with gender-associated names.

Fine-tuning models on ambiguous contexts from the BBQ dataset with generated polite stereotype-endorsing answers, then using an LLM judge to measure 'stereotype expression' on held-out questions. Also evaluated via an agentic incident review task that compares blame attribution between characters with race-associated names (e.g., Black and White names).

Fine-tuning models on left-, center-, and right-leaning news excerpts from the Qbias corpus, then using an LLM judge to evaluate the partisan 'slant' and 'net lean' of the models' generated responses to neutral questions about held-out news events.
